answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 153493 Country: India Title: Is Nikah Mandatory for Men Question: Is nikah mandatory for man suffering from mental illness (depression, anxiety, social phobia) and going to work regularly? Does Shariah provide exception for such person? Answer ID: 153493 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1352/1338/L=11/1438) In common situations, it is sunnah for each one whether he is fully healthy. If the said person is suffering from mental illness and it is feared that he cannot maintain the marital rights then it is not necessary to get him married. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
